name: DuskUI
description: Recolors the vanilla interface (menus, buttons, tooltips, sliders, tabs, HUD bars) into a black + curated accent-color theme. Client-side only; built to sit alongside Sodium, Lithium, and Wurst without conflicts.

duskui:compat.sodium: no shared mixin targets — Sodium replaces the chunk/entity renderer, DuskUI only touches Screen/Widget classes
duskui:compat.lithium: server/game-logic optimizations only, zero UI overlap
duskui:compat.wurst: DuskUI never mixes into Wurst's own ClickGUI classes, only vanilla ones, so both can theme independently
